g.text: AU01 · AUTOMATED BUMP, ALERT OR AUDIT
g.title: Dependabot/tooling/CI audit event
Assess affected dependencies, security, compatibility

g.text: AU03 · REVIEW ISSUE AND PR PROVENANCE
g.title: Check agent versus third-party ownership
New issues/major changes or sensitive decisions
Human retains consequential scope decisions
Automated update may already have a PR
Implement if the bot update needs small fixes
Alternative for broader failures

g.text: AU09 · VERIFY UPDATED PR AND CI
g.title: Do not regard quota-limited CI as passed
No auto-merge merely because tool generated update
